question: On the frozen 16-rule prefix-disjoint root panel, does one fixed-scale TDLeaf initialization produce a finite actual-terminal W/L/D signal relative to its own initialization under a capped uniform foe?

training.rules: All 16 frozen GENERATED_AND_COMPILED task2633 candidates, in candidate-index order.
training.initial_weights: Use task2625 initial_vector(1977, dimension=10); verify the exact same ten-coordinate vector for each rule. Fixed coordinate 0=1, scale=10, and the nine remaining coordinates are generated by the pinned uniform initialization; no human price priors.
training.learner: The task2621 fixed-scale Model/TDLeafEpisode adapter and task2625 TDLeaf/search-bootstrap update semantics; complete GameSession histories and supported promotion/drop/auxiliary/declaration semantics.
training.training_reward_authority: Only actual scoring rule terminals can supply terminal reward. Horizon, resource cutoff, non-scoring terminal, restart/no-contest and incomplete query remain UNKNOWN for terminal reward; search values remain training targets, not W/L/D labels.

evaluation.node_cap_assignment: For each candidate_seed, shuffle its 16 frozen evaluation family IDs with random.Random(977422 + candidate_seed); assign the first eight 20000 and the remaining eight 40000 combined two-side nodes. Use the same family cap for both endpoints and colors.
evaluation.outcome_authority: Actual terminal W/L/D only. Search cutoff, horizon, node/time cap, non-scoring terminal and incomplete slot are UNKNOWN or missing as appropriate; never impute a draw.
evaluation.interpretation: Finite one-initialization feasibility panel only. No seed stability, population effect, universal price ranking, or full Generic-domain transfer claim.

root_limits: The 2176 roots passed exact ordered action-prefix exclusion (lengths 1-8), source/history replay, active-feature and train/evaluation start-disjointness audits.
Prefix exclusion does not establish transposition or distributional independence.

The frozen active-feature predicate did not guarantee every one of the ten dynamic channels at root starts: training misses at least one channel on six rules; evaluation does so on fifteen rules, with a minimum of three active channels. Preserve the pool and report this limitation; do not resample or select on coverage.

budget.unit: seconds of cumulative process wall time, including any preparation/audit charged to this study, training, evaluation, validation, analysis and report generation

task2625_measured_reference.interpretation_limit: Same learner and aggregate nodes/slots, but four existing rules and different models/roots; actual speed does not guarantee speed on task2633 candidates.

budget.source_budget_note: The task2625 evaluation runner allowed 3600s while its training cap was 2400s; adding the 1200s lifetime preparation/audit/reporting reserve would total 7200s. For this new design only, cap evaluation at 3000s so lifetime allocations sum exactly to 6600s. Conservatively charge the projected 542.632s task2636 preparation/audit work already budgeted in the root plan, leaving 657.368s for future replay, analysis, and reporting; this is a budget allocation, not a claim of measured elapsed runtime. The remaining future budget is 6057.368s, including 2400s training and 3000s evaluation. Do not modify task2625 frozen plans or receipts. Execution must use one cumulative deadline/accounting receipt across phases; stop before the remaining allowance is consumed, preserve partial/missing slots, and never extend or retry based on results.
budget.estimate_limit: The 66.70-minute figure is a source-bound projection, not a runtime guarantee. The hard cap remains 110 minutes and counts validation/reporting; stop with complete partial/UNKNOWN evidence if reached.

registration_gates: No training or evaluation starts from this design record alone.
A separate write-once registration must pin its own exact adapted runner and audit sources, verify all input hashes, and implement the cumulative 6600-second deadline before any work starts.

The registration must bind the active session UUID/chat, all 16 candidate rule hashes, root plan/pool/audit hashes, the ten-coordinate initialization vector, the exact cap schedule, adapted training/evaluation/partial-audit/analyzer sources, and a new results/dev_aux/task2636/run-v1 directory with no prior start or output receipt.

Partial training and evaluation require new independent auditors: task2625 auditors accept only complete runs, and its analyzer refuses partial results. Keep all 512 predeclared pair strata in completion bounds; count a completed UNKNOWN endpoint separately from a missing slot, assign both an outcome range of [-1,+1], and never impute a draw.
If a revised estimate reaches 120 minutes, obtain explicit Chat mailbox assessment for that exact scope and budget before registration.

partial_semantics.training_incomplete: Flush and preserve all query/episode rows, stop reason, node counts, current model vectors and unfinished arms; independent partial replay must check every durable row. Do not evaluate incomplete models; mark evaluation not started and retain all 1024 planned slots as missing.
partial_semantics.evaluation_incomplete: Preserve each completed slot and query, explicitly list missing slot keys, and independently replay completed rows. A missing endpoint contributes the same conservative reward range [-1,+1] as UNKNOWN for the bound, while its missing state remains separately counted.
partial_semantics.analysis_denominator: Always use all 512 predeclared rule/family/color pairs, including pairs with one or both endpoints absent. Report known W/L/D, completed UNKNOWN, and missing separately; completion bounds are not confidence intervals.

cancellation_contract.global_deadline: Start one monotonic budget at the future registration/preflight boundary and charge every later stage; the remaining future allowance is6057.368 seconds. Training, evaluation, audit and report work use this shared deadline in addition to their stage caps.
cancellation_contract.search_callback: The task2492 AlphaBeta poll calls cancel every128 visited nodes and converts BudgetEnd into an incomplete receipt with a node count. The new wrapper must check global time and read the persistent role stop there; capture a stop request, raise BudgetEnd to return the receipt, write the incomplete query/episode or slot and final partial result, then stop without starting another sample.
cancellation_contract.external_stop: Do not let the raw PersistentStop exception escape from inside AlphaBeta if a partial receipt can be closed safely. Preserve STOPPED_USER as the final status after flushing the current record; never continue to another episode or slot.
cancellation_contract.hard_process_interruption: If the process is killed before its final receipt, retain the write-once started receipt and last fsynced JSONL prefix, record NO_FINAL_RECEIPT during read-only recovery, preserve any truncated trailing bytes outside the analytical row set, and do not retry or top up.
cancellation_contract.write_durability: Flush query rows as written; fsync after every closed training episode/evaluation slot and at phase/final status receipts (not every query). Close streams and write a final status before any audit. Independent partial auditors validate the exact newline-terminated durable prefix and complement it against the frozen slot/arm universe. Charge fsync/recovery checks to the fixed reserve.
